headline: The native program is training 100M-parameter models on 4,516 characters of text. No architecture or mechanism question can be answered at this data scale, and none of the round-1/round-2 rankings are informative.

data_scale.example_case_full_text:
What symptoms are you having?
I have sore throat.
data_scale.reading: Relative to the project's own historical Nano (3.15M params on 32.8M tokens = 10.4 tok/param, roughly data-matched), the native program scaled parameters UP 31.7x while scaling training tokens DOWN 7,263x. It is ~443,000x under a Chinchilla-optimal budget.

tokenizer_hypothesis.test: detokenize(hash_tokens(t)) == t over 470 corpus turn texts
tokenizer_hypothesis.note: The hash tokenizer is NOT the cause of degenerate span emission — exact emission is possible in principle. Note nanoscribe/test_native_p1_eval.py::test_hash_tokenize_detokenize_roundtrip_chars only asserts len(back)==len(text), which would not have caught a lossy tokenizer; the stronger identity check was run manually here.

arm_comparison.method: Conditional accuracy (correct/eligible) is confounded: arms answer different numbers of atoms, so accuracy is computed over different, self-selected subsets. Reported denominator-consistent as correct assertions per gold atom (n=150) with 95% Wilson intervals.

free_generation.note: under unconstrained decoding the evidence_bottleneck checkpoint covers zero gold atoms

briefing_LXII_answers.Q4_evidence_bottleneck_survived_100M: NO — does not separate from an untrained control
briefing_LXII_answers.Q5_span_port_survived_100M: NO — does not separate from an untrained control
briefing_LXII_answers.Q6_seed_variance: UNMEASURED but large: two same-seed 200-step runs differ 6.7x in final train loss
briefing_LXII_answers.Q7_complementary_strengths: CANNOT BE DETERMINED — arms overlap each other and the control
briefing_LXII_answers.Q8_hybrid_warranted: NO — no complementarity can be established at this data scale
briefing_LXII_answers.Q9_30M_to_100M_improvement: CANNOT BE DETERMINED — the dataset cannot support either size

decision.root_cause: TRAINING DATA SCALE, not architecture or mechanism
decision.rationale: Every observation is explained by 4.5 KB of training text: train loss -> 0.048 is memorization of 96 short examples; 0/150 free-generation coverage is absence of anything to generalize from; assertion accuracy at the majority-class prior is the only signal such a corpus carries; 6.7x run-to-run loss variance is expected at this size. Briefing SS LV: 'IF both 100M variants fail to improve meaningfully over 30M: do not move to 300M blindly; investigate data, training tokens, objectives, optimization, representation.' Data is the binding constraint.
do_not: spend further GPU on native arm tournaments
conclude anything about evidence_bottleneck vs span_port
attribute the degenerate output to the tokenizer (falsified)
required_next: Decide the native training-corpus strategy — this is the binding constraint and a program-level call
Any future arm comparison must ship with: random-init control, majority-class baseline, free-generation eval, denominator-consistent metrics
Strengthen the tokenizer round-trip test to assert identity, not just length
